standard_prerequisites.name: Lifting a mod-pi^8 resolution to a solution
standard_prerequisites.use: Performs the r = 1 step of the induction.

standard_prerequisites.name: Strictly standard elements survive base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps hypothesis (2) true after quotienting by pi_1^8 in the r > 1 step.

core_obligations: Induction on r. For r = 1 the hypotheses are exactly those of the desingularize-lifting-apply lemma, so the given mod-pi^8 resolution lifts to a resolution of R -> A -> Lambda superset q.

For r > 1 apply the induction hypothesis to R/pi_1^8R -> A/pi_1^8A -> Lambda/pi_1^8Lambda superset q/pi_1^8Lambda; property (2) for the remaining elements is preserved by the strictly-standard-base-change lemma, and the annihilator equalities of property (1) restrict to the quotient.
The lifted resolution of the quotient situation composed with the quotient maps resolves the original situation.
proof_roadmap: Base case through the lifting-apply lemma; induction step with base change; assembly.
difficulty_reason: A short induction whose base case delegates to the lifting-apply lemma and whose step is the base-change observation; both are carried.
